topics.title: Don't Be a Chhuchhundar in the Year of the Dhurandhar — Why Small-Caps Beat Your Home Loan EMI
topics.angle: Use the Dhurandhar cultural moment to challenge the 'play it safe with FDs and home loans' mindset. Show how small-cap SIPs can outperform a home loan EMI strategy, with real math from 1995-2026 data.
topics.trend_context: Dhurandhar 2 crossed Rs 559 Cr net in 6 days (approaching Rs 1000 Cr), India won back-to-back T20 World Cups — the national mood is aggressive and winning. Meanwhile, young professionals are trapped in 'Bad EMIs' for homes and cars.
topics.general_hook: Dhurandhar 2 just became the biggest Bollywood opener ever — and it teaches a finance lesson most people miss

topics.title: Your Savings Account Is Quietly Robbing You — The 2026 Money Shield Every 20-Something Needs
topics.angle: Expose the savings account as a 'leaking bucket' where inflation eats your money. With RBI repo rate at 5.25% and most savings accounts at 2.5-4%, your purchasing power is shrinking every month. Provide a 3-part 'Money Shield' — term insurance, inflation-beating SIP, and a 10% Memory Fund.
topics.trend_context: Iran War pushed oil to $170/barrel, Indian fuel prices rising, RBI repo at 5.25% but bank savings rates lagging behind real inflation. The general public is unknowingly losing money by 'saving' it.
